create_visualbert_config: create a VisualBertConfig instance with custom model parameters for a visual BERT model
load_visualbert_config: load a VisualBertConfig from a pretrained checkpoint like uclanlp/visualbert-vqa-coco-pre
initialize_visualbert_model: initialize a VisualBertModel with a VisualBertConfig for vision-language tasks
configure_visual_embedding: configure VisualBertConfig with custom visual_embedding_dim and bypass_transformer settings
inspect_visualbert_config: inspect VisualBertConfig attributes like hidden_size, num_hidden_layers, and vocab_size
